name: us-premium-tax-credit-8962
description: Compute the 2026 premium tax credit under section 36B and reconcile advance payments on Form 8962. Covers who can claim the credit, household income and the 2025 federal poverty lines the 2026 form uses, the applicable percentage table in Rev. Proc. 2025-25, the 9.96 percent employer-coverage affordability percentage, the return of the 400 percent of the poverty line limit after the 2021 through 2025 expansion, and repayment of excess advance payments in full with no cap. Trigger on premium tax credit, PTC, APTC, Form 8962, Form 1095-A, Marketplace subsidy, excess advance premium tax credit. Federal only. The self-employed health insurance deduction is in us-self-employed-health-insurance.
